svg.title: GCP us-west1 outage: fiber maintenance and failed rerouting, night illustration
svg.desc: Buildopsy illustration of the August 20, 2026 us-west1 incident: two data centers linked by an inter-datacenter fiber route. The primary link is under scheduled fiber maintenance with amber warning lights and a service truck, an alternate path carries a queue of packets glowing red while packets drop off the path, and a status panel reads primary under maintenance and alternate congested. Illustration, not Google's network topology; the final report publishes no capacity or traffic values.
svg.text: Scheduled fiber work cut inter-datacenter capacity.
Rerouting did not properly redistribute the load.
Buildopsy illustration, not Google's network topology.
The final report publishes no capacity or traffic values.
